---
name: Feature request / improvement
about: Propose a new feature or an improvement to an existing one
labels: enhancement
---

**Problem**
What's missing or awkward today? Link to the relevant `TODO.md` item if one
already exists.

**Proposed change**
What you'd add or change, and why this is the smallest change that solves it
(see `docs/SDLC.md`'s Definition of Done — new work should come with tests
and, if it changes a decision, an update to the relevant `docs/*.md`).

**Out of scope**
Anything explicitly NOT part of this request, to keep the change reviewable.
